name: Arcjet
description: Arcjet is the runtime security platform that ships in your AI code. Detect prompt injection, authorize agent tool calls, redact sensitive data, and block bots and abuse. Real-time security building blocks you call inside your app, before an action happens.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Arcjet to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Arcjet to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.arcjet.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Arcjet MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Arcjet lists 21 MCP tools, including analyze-traffic, create-rule, create-site, delete-rule, explain-decision, get-anomalies, get-dry-run-impact, get-guard, get-request-details, get-security-briefing, get-site-key, and get-site-quota.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Arcjet?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Arcjet in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Arcjet requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Arcjet is developed by Arcjet. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
